query: INSERT INTO live_location_pending(message_id, group_id, sender_id, updated_at_ms, expires_at_ms, data) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at_ms = excluded.updated_at_ms, data = excluded.data WHERE live_location_pending.sender_id = excluded.sender_id AND live_location_pending.group_id = excluded.group_id AND live_location_pending.updated_at_ms < excluded.updated_at_ms
